Done-when 3 is the sibling child #3119 (GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME, queued). Done-when 1's deployed `policy.json` block + usage-URL env is #3118's post-launch leg (acceptance 3) — it cannot ride the goal branch, because the assembly squash would land the policy key before the image that reads it. `goal-lint` 0 FAIL (1 WARN: no `blockedBy` edge — the two children share only `sessions.md`, so the footprint hold serialises them in either order). The ⚑ flag's `→ work #3108` stays live: this issue's PR deletes it.

blocked-on: human

Round 1 built and verified the Go headroom poll (pytest 958 passed, spec gate 0 red, 12 Go rows green), but no PR was opened. The worker's `pr-open` gate needs `uv sync` to reach PyPI, and its pod has no python egress.

Salvaged branch: `fix/issue-3108-go-headroom-poll` (1 commit ahead of `goal/3118-go-headroom`). The PR body draft was in the pod's `/tmp`, so it is not on the branch.

Needed from a human: open the PR from that branch, base `goal/3118-go-headroom`, with the body the worker described (footprint deviations: `app.py`, `sessions.py`, `metrics.py`, `specs/README.md`, `specs/worlds/README.md`, `tests/fixtures/policy-go.json` and a one-token rename in `tests/test_codex_upstream_headers.py`). Or re-dispatch round 2 with `--work-branch fix/issue-3108-go-headroom-poll` from a ride that has python egress.

Parked `agent/blocked` (not re-dispatched): the strike was counted `unknown`, with no provider to exclude. Goal #3118 acceptance 3–4 remain post-launch and are not part of this child.
